top.title: UAE Property: 'When does a Dubai off-plan property delay become a red flag?'
top.teaser: Question: My husband and I bought our first Dubai property off-plan in 2023. We weren't investors – the plan was to move into it when our current tenancy ended. The original handover was supposed to be this year, but the developer has now pushed it back and construction still doesn't look anywhere near finished. We have paid 60 per cent of the purchase price and are also paying Dh135,000 ($36,760)
top.impact_reason: Delays affect buyer move-in dates and developer reliability.
top.headline: Managing off-plan property delays in Dubai
top.summary: Buyers facing construction delays on their off-plan purchases need to understand when project postponements signal serious risks. Developers pushing past handover dates create uncertainty for resident buyers relying on timely completion.
top.why: Off-plan delays directly impact buyer timelines and financial planning.
